subject: Mutual Action Cookbook & Launch Rhythm — MedSys pilot
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rivera <emma@ribera.ai>, Sanjay Kumar <sanjay.kumar@medsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Cookbook & Launch Rhythm — MedSys pilot

Hi Emma / Sanjay —

Great to connect yesterday. As promised, I attached a concise "MAP Cookbook" (PDF) and seeded a lightweight Launch Rhythm slide deck and an editable MAP doc to help structure the pilot runbook. The goal here is to produce a single-page, mutual-action plan the team can operationalize for the 8-week pilot.

Key pieces in the cookbook:
- Stakeholder roster + decision owner table
- Acceptance criteria matrix (functional + compliance)
- Week-by-week milestones with dependencies and owners
- Risk triggers and fallback policies (capacity / latency / data residency)

Requests / next steps:
1) Please review the Google Doc (link below) and add any missing stakeholders and compliance gates by EOD Tue (2028-07-25).
2) Confirm a 90-min kickoff workshop slot the week of 2028-07-31 so we can align scope and run a quick runbook rehearsal.
3) Flag any items in the acceptance matrix that will need legal / procurement involvement — we'll loop in our CS/Legal accordingly.

Links & attachments:
- MAP doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3MapCookbookEdit
- Launch Rhythm slides (view/edit): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1z9x-launch-rhythm-slides
- Attachment: MAP_Cookbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
- Template: launch_rhythm_template.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

I've also dropped a short checklist into the Doc for the acceptance criteria so it's easy to mark "Ready / Blocked / Needs Info."

Thanks — I assigned Marissa as the pilot PM on our side and Jonas as the technical lead to coordinate infra/latency SLOs. Connor will help with onboarding and integration timelines.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solution Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Rivera <emma@ribera.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay.kumar@medsys.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 12:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Cookbook & Launch Rhythm — MedSys pilot

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the materials — this is exactly what we need to get us out of planning paralysis. I skimmed the acceptance matrix and added a couple of compliance rows (PHI audit trail + key rotation cadence). Sanjay is looping in our InfoSec lead (copied here) and will confirm whether we need an on-prem agent for audit logs.

Couple of quick asks from our side:
- Can the kickoff be the week of 7/31? Prefer morning slots (ET) for the broader group.
- In the MAP doc, can you add a simple column for "Customer success metric" (e.g., latency < 200ms p95 / false-positive rate on PII detection < 0.5%)?

I'll get back with a short stakeholder list by Friday.

Cheers,
Emma Rivera
Product Manager, Ribera AI
emma@ribera.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Emma Rivera <emma@ribera.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Cookbook & Launch Rhythm — MedSys pilot

Naomi / Emma —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the materials. I've added week owners for weeks 0-4 and a named escalation path for "blocked by procurement." A couple of internal notes for our team (Jonas / Connor):
- Jonas: can you confirm estimated infra lead time for private deployment + KV cache configuration? We may need a 2-week buffer if we go with the on-prem audit log agent.
- Connor: I'll need a short list of the integration touchpoints (API contract + auth type) so I can populate the onboarding checklist.

Emma — I've added the "Customer success metric" column Naomi flagged and seeded a couple metrics; feel free to refine.

Naomi — I'll prep a 60-min agenda for the kickoff (alignment + tech breakout + acceptance run-through) and share proposed slots tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Pilot Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Emma / team —

Thanks for the updates, Emma & Marissa. I've bumped the MAP doc to v1.1 (see link) and added a short procurement checklist under the "operational gating" section. Updated doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3MapCookbookEdit

Proposed kickoff slots (ET):
- Tue 2028-07-31 09:00–10:30 ET
- Wed 2028-08-01 11:00–12:30 ET

Please confirm preferred slot by Monday 2028-07-24 so we can lock calendars.

Jonas: noted the 2-week buffer if the audit agent is required — can you confirm by EOD Mon so we can adjust the milestone dates in the MAP?

Connor: if you drop the integration touchpoint doc in the shared Drive folder, Marissa will link it into the onboarding checklist.

Best,
Naomi

I'll attach a short spreadsheet with the provisioning checklist and slot estimates.
